title: Hashes, commit ids and UUIDs: must not be flagged
summary: SHA-256 checksums, commit hashes and UUIDs assigned to ordinary field names. Covers 5 inputs.
rationale: Long random-looking values are everywhere in repositories and are public by nature.
unscopedReason: Authored detector and arrival-target metadata intentionally assign no credential family; this fixture remains a global benchmark control.
